variant_definitions.A: claim-first: the first frame is the strongest verified real image and the on-screen text states the claim or outcome in 6 words or fewer; spoken narration unchanged
variant_definitions.B: orientation-first (control, the form of SHORT1): the first frame carries place name and year, the claim follows after the first beat; spoken narration unchanged

rules: change only the declared factor between variants
measure each Short at the same age (measurement_window_days after publication) and record measurement_timestamp
publish in the assignment order; do not reassign after seeing numbers
do not stop early on a good-looking difference
